messages.kernel.pluginHelp: Enable the capabilities you need. Disabling a plugin keeps its data. Changes take effect after reloading.
messages.kernel.disableAllConfirm: Start with only the core? Your collection and local drafts will be kept.
messages.kernel.updateHelp: Check for updates from your chosen HTTPS registries. This release only reads metadata; installation and publication are manual.
messages.kernel.incompatible: Requires a different core or API version
messages.kernel.install: Install a local plugin or theme
messages.kernel.installHelp: Extract a trusted package into a folder, run the command in your project, then run npm run build. Exported configuration can replace config/extensions.json to publish your choices.
messages.kernel.trustHelp: Plugins run with page privileges. Declared API capabilities are not a security sandbox. Only install code you trust.
messages.kernel.themeHelp: Choose a presentation. Entry data and validation stay with plugins.
messages.kernel.builtinHelp: Minimal presentation, without an installed theme.
messages.kernel.themeFailure: Could not load the theme; using the core presentation.
messages.kernel.saved: Saved on this device. Export configuration to include it in the next build.
messages.kernel.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Enable browser storage to save extension preferences.
messages.kernel.storageConflict: Another tab changed these preferences. Reload before saving.
messages.kernel.recovery: Stored extension preferences could not be applied. Project defaults were loaded. Export the saved preferences before resetting.
messages.kernel.resetConfirm: Reset only extension preferences? Collection drafts will be kept.
messages.fieldKey.help: Stable semantic key, for example field.passport. Internal IDs remain unchanged.
messages.media.uploadHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Up to 10 MiB each, 60 MiB per package. Uploads are stored in the encrypted vault; unlock it first.
messages.privacy.visualHelp: Hidden and masked affect presentation only. Select Private to exclude a value from publication.
messages.privacy.entryHelp: Private entries and private fields are excluded from public exports and GitHub. Private data requires an unlocked vault. Existing entries keep their classification.
messages.vault.title: Privacy & Vault
messages.vault.help: The vault encrypts your full workspace and uploaded images on this device. Use at least 12 characters. Keep an encrypted backup and your passphrase separately; losing both access and the passphrase means losing the private data.
messages.vault.restore: Restore encrypted backup (enter its passphrase above)
messages.vault.restoreConfirm: Replace the current vault with this encrypted backup?
messages.badges.name: Badge name
messages.badges.needMedia: Enable Media to edit image badges. Emoji badges work independently.
messages.badges.help: Create reusable badges, then select them individually in New Entry or Edit. Legacy type assignments remain as defaults only for older entries without an individual selection.
messages.settings.projectScope: Project settings — included in public exports and GitHub changes.
messages.settings.localScope: Personal settings — saved only in this browser.
messages.github.help: Configure owner, repository and destination in Settings. Grant Contents: Read and write and Pull requests: Read and write for this repository. The token is kept only in memory. A PR saves to a new branch; merge and successful deployment update the site.
messages.github.review: Review these public file changes before submission.
messages.github.author: Commit author name
messages.github.title: Pull request title
messages.github.confirmPrompt: Submit the reviewed changes from {branch} to {base}?
messages.github.sending: Creating the commit and pull request…
messages.github.sent: Pull request created. Waiting for manual review and merge.
messages.workspace.warning: Public exports include permitted collection data and referenced images. Private data is excluded; use an encrypted vault backup to preserve it.
messages.workspace.format: Supports v1.0 snapshots and v1.1 collections in a complete public package. Upload files travel with the package.
messages.workspace.deviceSaved: Workspace changes saved on this device. Public changes are not published until the PR is merged and deployed.
messages.vault.locked: Vault locked — private data is unavailable until you unlock it.
messages.badges.title: Badges
messages.badges.pickerHelp: New entries start empty. Type a name and press Enter to select or create a badge. Saved with this entry.
messages.catalog.noDescription: Explore this entry and its connections.
messages.badges.duplicate: A badge with this name already exists. Select the existing badge.
messages.badges.colorHelp: Choose the background color. Text contrast adjusts automatically; image and emoji colors are preserved.
messages.badges.colorInvalid: Use a six-digit hex color, such as #16783a.
messages.fieldFormat.label: Number format
messages.fieldFormat.help: Year keeps the integer value and displays it without thousands separators.
messages.fieldPicker.label: Fields
messages.fieldPicker.help: Type and press Enter to select an existing field or create a reusable text field. Save the form to keep your changes. Use Custom field for other value types and rules.
messages.fieldPicker.ambiguous: More than one field matches this name. Choose the intended field from the suggestions.
messages.badges.dimensionsHelp: Sizes are in pixels. Width 0 is automatic; height is a minimum so text stays readable. Background color is configured above.
messages.badges.styleInvalid: Check badge dimensions and border values. Use the ranges shown in each field.
messages.catalog.startEmpty: Your collection is empty. Create your first entry to get started.
messages.github.conflictHelp: Your build and the destination branch have different source files. Export your local work before updating the deployed project. After merging a PR, wait for deployment and reload before making the next edit. Review the conflict details before proceeding.
